The single-tool server work (#17) has also started, explicitly gated as non-shipping until #15’s six-target evidence is real. content.text: The QuickJS hang now has a proven root cause and fix: the worker’s async stdout adapter could stall after evaluation, and the test’s PID probe accidentally resolved a local hanging `kill` wrapper. After switching bounded frames to direct pipe writes and pinning `/bin/kill`, the replacement test passed 10/10 and both debug and locked release containment passed 8/8 with no survivors. The #17 review then found three adapter-boundary issues; those are being fixed now without another review pass.
